description.value:
Just a few barefoot steps from the best breaks on the south coast, we’re your laid-back base for surf, sun, and island vibes. Whether you’re a total beginner or chasing your next big ride, our experienced instructors will guide you through every step – with surf lessons tailored to your skill level, your pace, and your style.

We’re not just about riding waves — we’re about living the surf lifestyle. Wake up to salty air, chase tropical swells, chill with new friends, and soak up the local island culture. Our surf packages are flexible, affordable, and designed to give you the most epic experience, no matter your budget.

description_about.value:
Welcome to Cheeky Monkey Guesthouse, founded by Baba and proudly run by the Dodangoda family. Named after Baba, our Baba’s Surf Shop sits right alongside the guesthouse – together creating a space that’s all about surf, community, and the authentic spirit of Sri Lanka.

As one of the oldest guesthouses with a surf shop in Midigama, we’ve been sharing the stoke with travelers from all over the world for years. Staying with us means you’re not just a guest – you’re part of the family. Our tropical haven offers a laid-back, welcoming vibe where you can truly experience our beautiful country.

Whether you’re here to catch your first wave, improve your surf skills, or simply soak up the island vibes, we’ve got you covered. Join us for surf sessions, unwind with yoga, or just kick back with good company in our café.

At Cheeky Monkey, we love nothing more than welcoming new faces into our ever-growing family. Come as a stranger, leave as a friend – and take a piece of Sri Lanka’s surf culture with you.

quotes.text: I spent 2 months living in this hostel and I couldn't find a better place. The guys working there are lovely and helpful. Yehan and Palitha are honestly the best. The rooms are really clean. The location is amazing. The surf shop is owned by Chulanga and the prices are so good. He even helped me to fix a surfboard that I rented in other place!!! Chill place and 1 minute walking from one of the best spots for surfing.
quotes.title: Lovely place in the best location.
quotes.author: Tomas, Spain

quotes.text:
I had an amazing stay at Cheeky Monkey Hostel. The staff and the owner were absolutely amazing and extremely helpful from start to finish. They helped me with everything I needed, organized things for me (like airport pick-up, new room etc), and even took great care of me when I was sick. Ishan especially checked in on me regularly to make sure everything was okay, which was great. 

The room was spacious, clean, and comfortable. Even though the hostel is located by the road, it’s surprisingly quiet and peaceful. It’s also not a party hostel, which made it a really nice place to stay.

As a solo traveler, I felt very safe and well looked after the entire time. Great atmosphere, great people, and a place that truly makes you feel welcome. I would definitely come back and highly recommend this hostel to anyone visiting the area.
quotes.title: Amazing stay with super friendly and helpful staff
quotes.author: Sofie, Norway

quotes.text: Cheeky monkey is in the best location between two great surf locations. There is also nearby restaurant and cafes so we didn’t have to hire a scooter to access everything we needed for our stay. The staff were awesome and helped with board hire, staying extra nights, and arranging taxis. Great value for money at cheeky monkey - highly recommend 👍 clean, affordable, friendly staff too.
quotes.title: Excellent value for money, clean, great location and friendly helpful staff!
quotes.author: Jimmy, Australia

quotes.text: Best place to stay in Midigama, right next to best surfing spots and has a billards table. Guys are extremely helpful and friendly, if you are seeing this, you should give it a try for a couple of days I am sure you will want to extend your stay!
quotes.title: Perfect
quotes.author: Serkan, Turkey

quotes.text: Cheeky Monkey was very comfortable and clean and the staff were all very kind and helpful. Loved the location as it was not overly touristy but still close to everything and right by the ocean with great views! Mostly chill accomodation/surf shops/restaurants in the area rather than big resorts etc. Definitely recommend to stay here if you are here to surf and not get too caught up in the overcrowded tourist areas.
quotes.author: Ligaya, New Zealand

quotes.text:
All was good with our room, it was clean and comfortable and wifi was great!
There is a nice chilling area with pool table and bar, which was the perfect evening activity for us as it was raining. The staff was friendly and the area is nice with the sea right in front and just a short walk to the beach. Would stay here again!
